agreed_points.statement: An authenticated API access event occurred.
The reproducibility of the original watermark observation is materially contested.

disputed_points.statement: How much evidentiary weight should remain assigned to the original watermark observation after the failed reproduction.

positions.position: treat the watermark component as insufficiently stable for positive derivation support

unresolved_points.statement: Whether outputs obtained through the authenticated API access event were incorporated into downstream model training.
unresolved_points.unresolved_reason: The available evidence establishes access but does not establish downstream training incorporation.

basis: both opinions agree on the existence of authenticated access
both opinions agree that watermark reproducibility is contested
the auditors disagree about the residual evidentiary weight of the original watermark observation
causal downstream training use remains unresolved
limitations: the reconciliation does not resolve causal training use
numerical agreement is not treated as an automatic verdict
